title: Two-Clustering Regime of Token Dynamics in Causal Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.18088v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We partially resolve Conjecture 1 of [Karagodin et al., Clustering in Causal Attention Masking (NeurIPS 2024)] and extend it to time-dependent parameter regimes. The conjecture predicts that causal attention dynamics converge to two clusters aligned with the eigenvectors associated with the largest eigenvalue $\lambda_{\max}$ of the value transformation. We prove that this behavior holds when $\lambda_{\max}>0$ and is generally false when $\lambda_{\max}\le0$. The resulting two-cluster regime is common in practice and substantially more challenging than the classical single-cluster setting studied previously. A central contribution of our work is the identification of a rigorous dimension reduction phenomenon: despite evolving in a high-dimensional embedding space, token trajectories collapse onto a two-dimensional structure governed by a small number of dominant directions. translated_title: 因果注意力中Token动力学的双聚类状态
translated_abstract: 我们部分解决了 [Karagodin 等，Clustering in Causal Attention Masking (NeurIPS 2024)] 中的猜想 1，并将其扩展到时间相关的参数区域。该猜想预测，因果注意力动力学收敛到与值变换最大特征值 λ_max 相关联的特征向量对齐的两个聚类。我们证明了当 λ_max > 0 时该行为成立，而当 λ_max ≤ 0 时通常不成立。由此产生的双聚类状态在实践中很常见，且比先前研究的经典单聚类情形更具挑战性。我们工作的一个核心贡献是识别出一个严格的降维现象：尽管Token轨迹在高维嵌入空间中演化，但它们会坍缩到一个由少数主导方向支配的二维结构上。基于这一见解，我们引入了一种新的分析框架……
tldr: 本文部分证明了因果注意力动力学在值变换最大特征值为正时收敛为与主导特征向量对齐的双聚类的猜想，并揭示了高维Token轨迹坍缩到由少数主导方向支配的二维结构的严格降维现象。
en_tdlr: This paper partially proves the conjecture that causal attention dynamics converge to two clusters aligned with dominant eigenvectors when the largest eigenvalue is positive, and identifies a rigorous dimension-reduction phenomenon in which high-dimensional token trajectories collapse onto a two-dimensional structure governed by a few dominant directions.
